if CarId == PlayerId then getObj("player_veh_loc1"):SetPosition(CVector(20,0,20)) getObj("player_veh_loc2"):SetPosition(CVector(20,0,20)) getObj("player_veh_loc3"):SetPosition(CVector(20,0,20)) getObj("player_veh_loc4"):SetPosition(CVector(20,0,20)) println("Player cannot enter the car because he is alone in the location.")
